lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Denise, this is Pierre. Is this an okay time to talk?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, sorry, I'm in the car but I can talk.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before we start, is there anything on your mind you want to make sure we get to today?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sounds good to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Are you feeling okay this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, rough week. My back is acting up.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So did you manage to take a 10-minute walk after dinner on 4 days?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I did it! 4 out of 4 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You kept going even on a hard week. That says a lot about you.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're really honest with yourself, and that helps.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What did you notice on the days it went well?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've picked your days.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you cook on Sundays?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, not yet. I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've made up your mind.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is anyone else at home able to cook?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Let's say I cook at home 3 nights.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 7.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 7 and not a 4?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 4 out of 4 days, the hard part was the rain, and next week you're going to cook at home 3 nights. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Monday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Denise. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Pierre. Bye!

tags.note: Yes/no check-in on how the week went
Reports back pain; minor symptom, not explored
Minimal acknowledgment; back pain not followed up
Past attempts did not last; barrier to change
Fridge reminder worked as a strategy
Plans a phone alarm as a step
States ability to manage three days
Pushes toward 5 days after participant said 3
Notes no one else can cook yet
Desire to feel like herself again
Summary includes rain, which participant never mentioned

flags.reason: Directive 'You have to make this a priority' pushes without permission and undercuts autonomy.
After participant offered 3 days, coach asked whether 5 was realistic, pushing a higher target.
Summary says 'the hard part was the rain,' but participant cited back pain and never mentioned rain.
Back pain reported as 'acting up' was acknowledged with 'I see' and never explored or checked for safety.
'It never lasts' was met with affirmation, not exploration of the ambivalence behind it.

score.summary: Denise reported strong adherence and generated her own plan, with the coach eliciting change talk well through open questions and affirmations. However, the coach directed her toward 5 days and told her she 'has to' prioritize this, and the summary introduced a rain barrier she never mentioned while her back pain went unexplored.
strengths: Line 9 and line 10: coach affirmed the 4 of 4 walking days and her persistence on a hard week.
Line 17 and line 19: open questions drew out her own strategy (fridge reminder) and next step.
Line 44: closing summary and asking 'Did I miss anything?' invited correction.
coaching_tips: Line 35: replace 'You have to make this a priority' with an autonomy-supporting question, e.g., 'What would make this a priority for you?'
Line 28: after she said 3 days, respect her number rather than asking about 5; ask permission before suggesting more.
Line 44: avoid adding details not said; the rain was never mentioned, so reflect her back pain instead.
Line 6 and line 12: explore the back pain and the 'it never lasts' sustain talk with an open question before affirming.
